# Supplied setup documentation

Customer task: a newly invited editor must complete workspace activation. The
approved procedure requires accepting the emailed invitation, signing in, opening
Settings > Activation, and entering the one-time code. All steps are required.
No other permissions, fees or steps are required in this synthetic product.

Current draft /activate:
"Sign in. Open Settings > Activation. Enter the one-time code."

Current quick reference /activate-card:
"Accept your emailed invitation. Sign in. Open Settings > Activation. Enter the
one-time code."
The card is intentionally brief. Both documents target this same task and version.
